h1: Sheng Ji Items Needed: Written List, Privacy and Safety
heroSub: No self-collection instructions · Verify purpose, recipient, shipping and disposal first

sections.h2: Obtain the written materials list first

items.content: The provider’s traditional process may request hair, nail clippings, a previously worn garment and birth details. Before paying, obtain an itemised list covering purpose, recipient, retention period, privacy and final handling.

items.h3: If a biological sample is requested
items.content: This website does not provide self-collection instructions. Ask whether a non-invasive alternative is available. If a biological sample is still requested, consult a qualified healthcare professional and confirm courier and customs rules.
Birth date and time, legal name, contact details and video records should be treated as sensitive personal data and shared only with a verified recipient who has a clear need.

items.h3: Verify the recipient and trackable address
items.content: Do not send personal items or biological material to an unverified person. Use tracking and keep the written list, shipping record and receipt confirmation.

items.h3: Follow courier and customs rules accurately
items.content: Restrictions vary by location. Ask the courier and customs authority whether the item is allowed and how it must be declared. Do not use an inaccurate description to avoid inspection.
Obtain written terms covering where items are kept, who may access them, when they are used, whether they are returned and how unused material is destroyed.

A guardian should assess participation carefully and protect the child’s privacy. Do not use exam, health or family anxiety to create urgency, and do not instruct a minor to collect a biological sample.

items.h3: Do not submit another person’s items without consent
items.content: Do not collect or send another person’s hair, nails, garment, birth data or biological material without their informed consent.
If safety, privacy, shipping or purpose is unclear, pause preparation and payment and request complete written instructions via WeChat NSDG521 or the public email address.
